panels.title: Ledger Build Rate [$xrpl_network_type]
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How many new ledgers this node finishes building per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of completed ledger-build operations, averaged over 5 minutes and split by node.*

###### Reading it:
*A steady flat line; the value should track the network close cadence.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 0.2-0.3 ledgers/sec on mainnet (roughly one every 3-5s); workload-dependent on test networks.*

###### Watch for:
*A drop toward zero (node fell out of sync or stalled) or a value well above the network rate (rebuilding history).*

###### Keywords:
- **Ledger build** *(per node)* — constructing the new ledger by applying the agreed transaction set to the prior ledger.
- **Ledger close interval** *(network-wide)* — the network's steady ledger rhythm — roughly one closed ledger every 3-5 seconds on Mainnet.

###### Computation boundary:
*Result: Per node — each series is one server's own value.*
*Recorded in code as a trace span, turned into a metric by the collector (SpanMetrics connector), then aggregated by the Grafana query.*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp)

###### Function:
`buildLedgerImpl`

###### References:
[Ledger build](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/ledgers/open-closed-validated-ledgers) · [Ledger close interval](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/ledgers/ledger-close-times) · [Telemetry glossary](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/docs/telemetry-glossary.md#ledger-build)

panels.title: Ledger Validation Rate [$xrpl_network_type]
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How often ledgers reach full validation (accepted by the trusted validator quorum) per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of ledger-validation events over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Should closely match the build rate under normal, in-sync operation.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; workload-dependent elsewhere.*

###### Watch for:
*A validation rate that lags the build rate, signalling the node is building ahead of the network consensus it trusts.*

###### Keywords:
- **Ledger validation** *(network event)* — the second consensus stage where the node confirms a built ledger matches the trusted validator quorum and marks it final.
- **Validation quorum** *(network-wide)* — the minimum number of agreeing trusted validations needed to declare a ledger fully validated.
- **Ledger build** *(per node)* — constructing the new ledger by applying the agreed transaction set to the prior ledger.
- **Consensus** *(network event)* — the protocol by which validators agree on the next ledger's transaction set and close time.

###### Computation boundary:
*Result: Per node — each series is one server's own value.*
*Recorded in code as a trace span, turned into a metric by the collector (SpanMetrics connector), then aggregated by the Grafana query.*

###### Source:
[LedgerMaster.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp)

###### Function:

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The time taken to build a single ledger, at the 95th percentile.*

###### How it's computed:
*95th-percentile of ledger-build durations over a 5-minute window, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Lower is better; the line should stay well under the ledger interval.*

###### Healthy range:
*Typically tens to low hundreds of milliseconds; workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*Sustained rises approaching the close interval, which indicate heavy transaction sets or disk/I/O pressure.*

###### Keywords:
- **Ledger build** *(per node)* — constructing the new ledger by applying the agreed transaction set to the prior ledger.
- **Ledger close interval** *(network-wide)* — the network's steady ledger rhythm — roughly one closed ledger every 3-5 seconds on Mainnet.

###### Computation boundary:
*Result: Per node — each series is one server's own value.*
*Recorded in code as a trace span, turned into a metric by the collector (SpanMetrics connector), then aggregated by the Grafana query.*

[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp)

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration Heatmap
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The full distribution of ledger-build times over the window, not just a single percentile.*

###### How it's computed:
*Counts of ledger builds falling in each duration band per 5-minute window, shown as color density.*

###### Reading it:
*A tight low band is healthy; scattered high cells mean occasional slow builds.*

###### Healthy range:
*Most mass concentrated in the low-millisecond bands; workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*A second cluster of hot cells at high durations (bimodal build times) hidden by percentile charts.*

###### Keywords:
- **Ledger build** *(per node)* — constructing the new ledger by applying the agreed transaction set to the prior ledger.

###### Computation boundary:

panels.title: Ledger Store Rate [$xrpl_network_type]
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How often completed ledgers are written into ledger history per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of ledger-store operations over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Should match the build rate during normal operation.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; can burst higher while backfilling history.*

###### Watch for:
*A store rate below the build rate (storage falling behind) or a stall at zero.*

###### Keywords:
- **Ledger store** *(per node)* — writing a completed ledger into the node's ledger history on disk.
- **Ledger build** *(per node)* — constructing the new ledger by applying the agreed transaction set to the prior ledger.
- **Back-fill / catch-up** *(per node)* — fetching missing historical ledgers from peers to fill gaps or reach the network tip.
- **Consensus stall** *(per node)* — a health check reporting that consensus is not making forward progress.

###### Computation boundary:
*Result: Per node — each series is one server's own value.*
*Recorded in code as a trace span, turned into a metric by the collector (SpanMetrics connector), then aggregated by the Grafana query.*

###### Source:
[LedgerMaster.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp)

panels.title: Build vs Close Duration
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Ledger build time compared with the full consensus round duration, both at the 95th percentile.*

###### How it's computed:
*Two 95th-percentile duration series over 5 minutes: ledger construction (ledger.build span) and the whole consensus round from open to accept (consensus.round span), per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Build should sit well below the round; the gap is consensus wait time (proposing, converging, validating) outside construction.*

###### Healthy range:
*Round tracks the network close interval (~3-5s on mainnet); build is a fraction of it (tens to hundreds of ms).*

###### Watch for:
*Build time approaching the round duration — construction is dominating the close and leaving little slack.*

###### Note:
*The close series uses consensus.round, not consensus.ledger_close: the latter span only wraps the onClose() prologue (sub-millisecond) and is not the ledger close time.*

###### Keywords:
- **Consensus round** *(network event)* — one propose-and-revise iteration of consensus; several may run before validators converge on a ledger.
- **Ledger build** *(per node)* — constructing the new ledger by applying the agreed transaction set to the prior ledger.
- **Consensus** *(network event)* — the protocol by which validators agree on the next ledger's transaction set and close time.
- **Consensus mode** *(per node)* — the node's role/health in the current round: Proposing, Observing, Wrong Ledger, or Switched Ledger.
- **Ledger close interval** *(network-wide)* — the network's steady ledger rhythm — roughly one closed ledger every 3-5 seconds on Mainnet.
- **Ledger close** *(network event)* — the current open ledger is closed and a new closed ledger is built from the agreed transaction set.

###### Computation boundary:
*Result: Per node — each series is one server's own value.*
*Recorded in code as a trace span, turned into a metric by the collector (SpanMetrics connector), then aggregated by the Grafana query.*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp) · [RCLConsensus.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp)

`buildLedgerImpl ; RCLConsensus::Adaptor::onClose (round span)`

panels.title: Ledger Close Interval & Age
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The wall-clock time between consecutive ledger closes — the network close cadence.*

###### How it's computed:
*Close Interval: 1 / rate(ledgers_closed_total), the average seconds between closes from the monotonic close counter (scrape-independent, unlike a gauge delta which would alias to the scrape period). Last-Close Age: time() minus the last-close network time (server_info last_close_time gauge + Ripple-epoch offset), i.e. seconds since the last ledger closed.*

###### Reading it:
*A steady line near the network's target close interval.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 3-5s on mainnet; workload-dependent on test networks.*

###### Watch for:
*A rising interval (consensus slowing or the node lagging) or a flat line at zero (ledgers no longer closing).*

###### Keywords:
- **Ledger close** *(network event)* — the current open ledger is closed and a new closed ledger is built from the agreed transaction set.
- **Ledger close interval** *(network-wide)* — the network's steady ledger rhythm — roughly one closed ledger every 3-5 seconds on Mainnet.
- **Consensus** *(network event)* — the protocol by which validators agree on the next ledger's transaction set and close time.

###### Computation boundary:
*Result: Per node — each series is one server's own value.*
*Computed in xrpld code (MetricsRegistry, OpenTelemetry SDK) and exported as a metric; the collector only forwards it; the Grafana query selects and aggregates it.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp) · [RCLConsensus.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp)

###### Function:

###### References:
[Ledger close](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/ledgers/open-closed-validated-ledgers) · [Ledger close interval](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/ledgers/ledger-close-times) · [Consensus](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/consensus-structure) · [Telemetry glossary](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/docs/telemetry-glossary.md#ledger-close)
